3.t: And scouring to the raid at dawn,

4.t: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,

5.t: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),

6.t: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord

7.t: And lo! he is a witness unto that;

8.t: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.

9.t: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth

10.t: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,

11.t: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
